commentary: Market breadth remains severely depressed at a breadth score of 26, compounded by the Nifty's eight-week losing streak. Stan Weinstein’s stage discipline and William O’Neil’s market-direction rules mandate extreme defensiveness under a 'WEAK' market gate. In confirmed corrections, three out of four equities inevitably succumb to broad-market gravity, regardless of individual chart structure. While resilient themes in energy logistics, electrical infrastructure, and specialty packaging are carving out constructive Stage 2 bases, Jesse Livermore’s fundamental rule—respect the general trend—takes precedence. Traders should avoid aggressive capital outlay, enforce Minervini-style stop discipline, and cap candidates with decelerating earnings at Watch until market breadth decisively confirms an accumulation day.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA / O'Neil CANSLIM / Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Trades near its 20-session pivot above the 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA on 2x average volume. However, the pattern lacks tightness, and overhead resistance looms large without broader institutional sponsorship or true relative-strength leadership.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Operating margins remain compressed at 3-5%, paired with poor trailing return metrics (ROCE ~5.6%, ROE ~3.6%). Combined with a severe quarterly revenue contraction of -56.3%, the stock violates CANSLIM's C-and-A criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis invalidates below 97.24. Exit swiftly if support breaks, as weak fundamentals amplify downside during broader market selloffs.

ADFFOODS.technical: Crisp SEPA breakout clearing a 20-session high on 2.74x average volume. The structure satisfies Minervini's trend template across the 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, with an RSI of 56 indicating constructive momentum without short-term extension.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Virtually debt-free packaged food player delivering steady 25.9% sales growth and resilient operating margins near 18%. Healthy ROCE above 22% underscores capital efficiency, though EPS growth must accelerate further to meet full CANSLIM standards.
ADFFOODS.risk: Fails on a close below 309.63. Honor the stop immediately to mitigate risk in a weak general tape.

AEGISLOG.technical: Exemplary Stage 2 power trend printing a three-up continuation thrust off the rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA. Price action remains well above the upward-sloping 200-SMA, accompanied by above-average volume expansion and an RSI of 58 reflecting robust institutional sponsorship.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Dominant LPG and liquid logistics player showing massive earnings leverage (+268.9%) and 38.2% sales expansion. Operates with expanding operating margins, superior ROCE (~19%), and an unbroken 30-year dividend track record confirming high institutional quality.
AEGISLOG.risk: Setup fails below 1383.26. Cut losses quickly if crude volatility sparks broad distribution across the energy complex.

ALICON.technical: Explosive 20-session pivot breakout powered by 10.48x average volume. The stock satisfies key Trend Template criteria, trading firmly above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA lines with MACD confirming positive Stage 2 momentum above zero.
ALICON.fundamental: Auto component specialist benefiting from structural electrification transitions, logging 38.3% revenue expansion. Balance sheet leverage is manageable (debt-to-equity ~0.51), but operating margins (~9-10%) and ROCE (~10.7%) indicate only partial CANSLIM fundamental quality.
ALICON.risk: Pivot fails below 790.64. Heavy-volume breakouts that reverse sharply require prompt liquidation under Minervini risk discipline.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Textbook double-bottom base with an inside-day compression near the pivot. Price respects rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA moving averages, while an RSI of 64 exhibits outstanding relative strength versus a sliding broader market.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Niche green packaging and IP provider demonstrating explosive triple-digit earnings (+151.2%) and revenue (+104.5%) acceleration. Supported by high operating margins (>35%), zero debt, and exceptional capital efficiency (ROCE 29.6%, ROE 21.2%).
ARROWGREEN.risk: Thesis breaks below 849.35. Adhere to strict stop rules to prevent rapid drawdowns in low-breadth environments.

ATLANTAELE.technical: Constructive double-bottom base with a decisive bullish engulfing candle on 3.2x average volume. Price holds firmly above its 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA; however, broad market drag warrants strict adherence to pivot confirmation.
ATLANTAELE.fundamental: Leading transformer supplier benefiting from grid capex, delivering 47.6% sales growth and closing FY26 debt-free. ROCE is outstanding (45.3%), but earnings growth decelerated from Q4's +128.6% to +50.4%, capping the setup at Watch per O'Neil discipline.
ATLANTAELE.risk: Pattern fails below 1804.62. Enforce strict loss-cutting discipline if heavy institutional distribution resurfaces.
